data.gender_notes: Aabidat is a feminine plural form used as a female name in Arabic and Urdu naming tradition.
data.short_meaning: Female worshippers; devout women (plural of ʿĀbidah)
data.long_meaning: Aabidat (عابدات) is an Arabic name meaning “Female worshippers; devout women”. It is the sound feminine plural of Arabic ʿābidah (عابدة) 'female worshipper', from the root ʿ-b-d 'to worship'. The form ʿābidāt denotes a group of women devoted to worship, and is used as a name in its own right.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aabidat carries the meaning Female worshippers; devout women. The name expresses collective devotion; this is its documented lexical sense rather than an added doctrinal claim.
data.etymology: Sound feminine plural of Arabic ʿābidah (عابدة) 'female worshipper', from the root ʿ-b-d.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabidat total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material achievement. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What does the name Aabidat mean?
faq.a: Aabidat means Female worshippers; devout women.

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aabidat?
What language does the name Aabidat come from?
faq.a: Aabidat is used in Arabic and Urdu.

faq.q: Is Aabidat a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aabidat is a feminine plural form used as a female name.

faq.q: How is Aabidat written in Arabic?
faq.a: Aabidat is written عابدات in Arabic and Urdu, and आबिदात in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aabidat?
faq.a: The root of Aabidat is ʿ-b-d (ع-ب-د), from ʿābidāt (عابدات).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aabidat?
faq.a: Aabidat is the sound feminine plural of Arabic ʿābidah (عابدة), female worshipper, from the root ʿ-b-d.

faq.q: Does Aabidat appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aabidat is not itself a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.
Aabidat is the feminine plural form ʿābidāt, meaning female worshippers. The singular is ʿĀbidah (عابدة).

faq.q: Is Aabidat the same name as Aabidah?
faq.a: They come from the same root and the same word family, but they are different forms: ʿĀbidah is singular (one female worshipper) and Aabidat is plural (female worshippers).

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aabidat verified?
faq.a: Yes. The meaning Female worshippers rests on the Arabic sound feminine plural ʿābidāt, from ʿ-b-d.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aabidat?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabidat total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is traditionally associated with ambition, authority and material achievement. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aabidat?
faq.a: Variants and alternative transliterations include Abidat and Aabidaat.

faq.q: Where is the name Aabidat used today?
faq.a: Aabidat circulates chiefly in Arabic and Urdu naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it.
